hints.title: Divisibility Criteria
hints.text: An integer x in [1, n] is counted if x % 3 == 0, x % 5 == 0, or x % 7 == 0.

hints.title: Iterate Range
hints.text: Loop from 1 through n and accumulate valid integers into a running sum.

hints.title: Inclusion-Exclusion Alternative
hints.text: One could also use arithmetic series for 3, 5, 7 and their products for an O(1) formula.

hints.title: Linear Accumulation Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass up to n.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear pass is instantaneous for n <= 1000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies simple divisibility filtering or arithmetic series.
